title: Trellus How-to Guides
summary: Browse practical Trellus guides for CRM setup, dialing skills, parallel dialing, callbacks and troubleshooting. Choose the task you need to finish.
body_markdown:
**How-to Guides**


Choose a guide for your next calling task: prepare a list, run a call block, save the outcome or schedule follow-up.


## Before your first call


[Check your microphone and headset before a calling session](https://www.trellus.ai/post/check-microphone-headset-before-calling) — inspect computer input/output, app and browser access, then use a local readiness worksheet.


[Prepare a fictional Google Sheets sample](https://www.trellus.ai/post/prepare-google-sheets-sample-for-trellus) — build two distinct tabs, four row cases and a column worksheet before connecting Trellus.


## Getting started


- [Download a sales call log template](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-call-log-template) — use the Excel workbook or CSV to record each attempt, its outcome and the next owner.
- [Add an auto dialer to your CRM](https://www.trellus.ai/post/crm-with-auto-dialer) — prepare one list, decide on call outcomes and callbacks, and use the first-session worksheet.
- [Evaluate a dialer in a one-week pilot](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-dialer-pilot-checklist) — define what the pilot must prove and inspect the saved results before deciding whether to buy.


## Dialing skills


- [Test a cold-call opener](https://www.trellus.ai/post/test-cold-call-opener) — compare openings around a defined question rather than treating a few conversations as a guaranteed winner.
- [Keep coaching useful without a call recording](https://www.trellus.ai/post/coach-sales-call-without-recording) — practice a specific moment without inventing what happened in an unrecorded call.


## Parallel dialing


- [Run an Attio call block](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-run-an-attio-call-block) — prepare a People list, choose the pace and finish the conversation with useful follow-up. Includes power and[parallel dialing](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) in the Attio walkthrough.
- [Choose a mode during CRM setup](https://www.trellus.ai/post/crm-with-auto-dialer) — use the mode-selection section of the setup guide before expanding the session.


## CRM workflows


- [Keep Salesloft calls and cadence actions connected](https://www.trellus.ai/post/salesloft-dialer) — check the Person, call activity, completed action and callback task.
- [Choose an Outreach calling workflow](https://www.trellus.ai/post/outreach-dialer) — compare native sequential dialing with Trellus power and parallel dialing, then check the saved result and task completion.
- [Set up a GoHighLevel call block](https://www.trellus.ai/learning-center/gohighlevel-parallel-dialer-setup) — choose the location and Smart List, then inspect the contact note, selected tag and callback.
- [Call from Google Sheets](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/google-sheets) — map your phone column and check the result on the original row.
- [Switch dialers without stranding callbacks](https://www.trellus.ai/post/switch-dialers-preserve-callbacks) — reconcile promises and ownership before moving the working list.
- [Check what a save acknowledgment proves](https://www.trellus.ai/learning-center/crm-save-acknowledgment-record-evidence) — distinguish an attempted save from the information found on the destination record.


## Call reporting


[Collect a call export beyond a capped response](https://www.trellus.ai/post/export-trellus-calls-without-row-cap) — use an interval ledger, replace retried results and leave unresolved coverage visible.


## Troubleshooting


- [Diagnose a pending GoHighLevel Manual Call item](https://www.trellus.ai/post/diagnose-gohighlevel-manual-call-task) — match the queue view, owner and workflow execution before changing a task.
- [Diagnose a stalled call block](https://www.trellus.ai/post/diagnose-stalled-call-block) — separate list exhaustion, research, conversations, after-call work and a failed workflow.


For the supported starting screen and platform-specific behavior, open the[integration directory](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations) . To discuss your own setup, bring the relevant worksheet to a[Trellus demo](https://www.trellus.ai/autodialer) .
